description: This file defines a Dropzone class for handling drag-and-drop image uploads and file insertion within a rich text editor, specifically integrated with Summernote editor.

classes.name: Dropzone
classes.description: A class managing drag-and-drop file upload and insertion functionalities for a Summernote editor instance.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Dropzone instance with context, sets up DOM elements and event handlers.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Attaches drag-and-drop event handlers based on options.

methods.name: attachDragAndDropEvent
methods.description: Sets up dragenter, dragleave, drop, and related event handlers for drag-and-drop functionality.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes all event handlers attached by this Dropzone instance.
